description: PHYSICALITY - THE REFEREE'S BAR, LOWERED 10%. WHAT CHANGES: one number. The foul-level function 0x143d861f0 compares the contact score against a threshold T and gives a free kick when score >= T. Outside the penalty area T is 40; this pack makes it 36. Everything that currently scores 36-39 - the contacts you watch and think 'that was a foul' - becomes a free kick. The IN-BOX threshold of 60 is deliberately NOT changed: penalties decide matches and that bias deserves its own test. THIS IS THE ONLY LEVER IN THE SET THAT BUYS FREE KICKS WITHOUT BUYING CARDS. That is worth saying plainly, because the first draft of phys-late-challenge claimed the same thing and was wrong. The card lines are separate immediates tested against the score AFTER the threshold test - 'cmp sil, 0x50 / jae -> cmp sil, 0x6e / sbb eax, eax / add eax, 4' at 0x143d862b5-0x143d862dc - so lowering T moves which contacts get whistled at all and moves nothing about which get carded. The level-2 midpoint is computed as T + (80-T)/2, so it follows automatically: at T=36 it evaluates to 58 and level 2 fires at score >= 59. 80 and 110 do not move. Packs that raise the SCORE (phys-reckless-contact, and indirectly phys-tackle-commit through the repeat-offender escalation) do move cards; this one does not. WHO IT AFFECTS: everyone. The Judge is handed two player slots and never asks which side is human, so your own defenders concede more too. EVIDENCE: DEMONSTRATED (level a), and re-confirmed this pass. The level function was emulated end-to-end under Unicorn on the pristine image with its three callees stubbed, so only (score, victim slot, in-box bit) varied. Stock, outside the box: >=40 level 1, >=61 level 2, >=80 level 3, >=110 level 4. With this immediate overlaid at 36: >=36 level 1, >=59 level 2, 80 and 110 unchanged; in-box 60/71/80/110 unchanged either way. The instruction is 'mov ecx, 0x28' - a private immediate inside one instruction, not a shared constant, so nothing else in the game reads it. It is selected into eax by the cmovae at 0x143d862a9 when the penalty-area bit (bt eax, 0xb) is clear. WHAT TO LOOK FOR IN A MATCH: more free kicks in midfield, from contacts that used to be waved on, with no change in the number of bookings. THIS IS THE BROADEST LEVER IN THE WHOLE PHYSICALITY SET - it fires on shoulder-to-shoulder contact as well as on tackles. If the whistle starts feeling fussy rather than fair, this is the first thing to take back out. DO NOT run this at the same time as phys-reckless-contact or phys-tackle-commit on a first outing - all three raise the foul count by different routes. STRONGER VERSION: 32 (bytes B920000000). Do not go below about 32 in one step. REVERT: python tools/exe_patch.py remove tools/data/patches/phys-whistle-threshold.json

patches.name: outside-the-box foul threshold 40 -> 36
patches.note: mov ecx, 0x28 -> mov ecx, 0x24. ecx is moved into eax by the cmovae two instructions later when the penalty-area bit (bt eax,0xb) is clear; eax is then compared against the score with 'cmp al, sil / jbe'
